_about: Every word on the enrollment form (/admissions/enroll/), English with a `vi` block. The form itself is src/_includes/partials/enroll-form.njk and its script src/assets/js/enroll.js. The values a choice sends (`value`) stay in English so the office reads one set of words. The admission contract is kept in English on both pages (check-vi skips contractIntro and contract): put a Vietnamese text here only when PRA supplies one.

contractIntro: The undersigned Parent(s) and/or Guardian(s) (herein collectively referred to as “Parent(s)”) acknowledge and agree that this Admission Contract is a legally binding contract between Branch of Palm River Company Limited in Hoi An (herein collectively referred to as “the Company”) and such Parent(s) subject to acceptance of enrolment of an applicant by the Company.
contract: All fees must be paid in accordance with the published Schedule of Fees. The Company reserves the right to revise this Schedule at any time. Enrollment is contingent upon timely and full payment. If tuition is unpaid or delayed, enrollment may be canceled. No progress reviews will be issued until outstanding payments are resolved.
Tuition fees are non-refundable if a student withdraws or does not complete the academic year. For refund terms relating to meals and transportation, please refer to the Family Handbook.

In cases of force majeure (e.g., natural disaster, epidemic, war, etc.) that disrupt learning, the Company will take flexible action to uphold the academic year. The learning period includes pre-planned buffer days in case of flooding or storm-related closures. If additional disruptions occur, the Company will consider appropriate make-up solutions. Tuition will not be refunded in such cases, except for meals or transportation if applicable.

4.1. Parents have an obligation to ensure that they and their child/children will: support and abide by the Company’s stated philosophy, goals and objectives; comply with all Company Policies and Rules (as set out in the Family Handbook published to parents and students, and as amended from time to time); ensure that the Student will comply with the Company’s behavior policy/code of conduct and applicable rules and regulations. In the case of non-compliance with the Company rules, the Company reserves the right to suspend or expel the student. In this event, the Company may decide, in its sole discretion, not to provide any refund or reduction in fees already paid or payable. Parents shall compensate the Company for any damage caused by the student’s misconduct.

4.2. Parents are expected to work closely and cooperatively with the Company throughout the student’s enrollment, including main programs, extracurricular activities, and remote learning courses if applicable.

4.3. Parents guarantee that all information submitted to the Company is accurate and up to date. The Company is not liable for any failure to contact the family or provide notices if updated information is not provided.

4.4. In emergencies where the Company cannot reach either parent or emergency contacts, the Company has the right to initiate appropriate medical action. Parents will be responsible for all related expenses.
4.5. If the Company requires parental approval, it is sufficient to obtain approval from one parent.
4.6. If the Company is unable to reach parents through multiple methods (calls, messages, emails), it reserves the right to determine the final course of action.
4.7. Parents and students agree to uphold the Company’s reputation, both online and offline. Any actions deemed harmful to the Company’s image may result in suspension or expulsion without refund.
4.8. Unless otherwise informed, the Company assumes the student will participate in all programs, activities, and events organized during the academic year.

Both the Company and the Parents agree to engage in all future negotiations and dealings with each other in a spirit of good faith to uphold the terms of this agreement and the best interests of the Student. Parents are expected to communicate positively with the Academy and its community, both in public and private forums. All communication should aim for positive and constructive resolutions.

The Company supports students in reviewing for international and domestic certificates according to the schedule and based on the agreement with parents. By signing this agreement, parents fully understand that the Company's programs do not replace the national core curriculum as required by the Ministry of Education and Training of Vietnam.

t.medicalText: I fully understand and accept that any medication brought to the Company must be accompanied by a written note from me as Parent/Guardian, and that the medication shall be submitted to the Company Nurse in the original pharmacy container(s) and marked with my child’s name, name of medication, its dosage, schedule and instructions. I fully understand and accept that it is my responsibility to notify the Company in writing of any changes to the information given in this medical section.
t.consentAsk: Please choose one of these two options
t.totalText: I consent to the unlimited use of my child’s photograph(s) by Company for promotional, educational, and other related purposes, including but not limited to publications, websites, social media, and presentations.
t.privateText: I consent to the use of my child’s photograph(s) by Company for private and class-chat only purposes, which may include internal documentation, class materials, and teacher/student/class communications.
t.policyText: I understand that Company will make reasonable efforts to honor the option I have selected above but cannot guarantee that my child's photograph(s) will not be captured incidentally during the Company activities or events. Additionally, I acknowledge that Company cannot control whether other parents or individuals will choose to post pictures or incidental photos of their child that may include my child.

vi.medicalText: Tôi hiểu rõ và chấp nhận rằng mọi loại thuốc mang đến Công ty phải kèm theo giấy ghi chú do tôi, với tư cách là phụ huynh hoặc người giám hộ, viết. Thuốc phải được giao cho y tá của Công ty, còn nguyên trong hộp hoặc lọ của nhà thuốc, có ghi tên con tôi, tên thuốc, liều dùng, giờ dùng và hướng dẫn sử dụng. Tôi hiểu rõ và chấp nhận rằng tôi có trách nhiệm thông báo bằng văn bản cho Công ty khi có bất kỳ thay đổi nào đối với thông tin trong phần y tế này.
vi.consentHead: Đồng ý sử dụng hình ảnh
vi.consentAsk: Ba mẹ vui lòng chọn một trong hai lựa chọn sau
vi.totalText: Tôi đồng ý cho Công ty sử dụng không giới hạn hình ảnh của con tôi cho mục đích quảng bá, giáo dục và các mục đích liên quan khác, bao gồm nhưng không giới hạn ở ấn phẩm, trang web, mạng xã hội và bài thuyết trình.
vi.privateText: Tôi đồng ý cho Công ty sử dụng hình ảnh của con tôi chỉ trong phạm vi nội bộ và nhóm trò chuyện của lớp, có thể bao gồm tài liệu nội bộ, tài liệu của lớp và trao đổi giữa giáo viên, học viên và lớp.
vi.policyText: Tôi hiểu rằng Công ty sẽ cố gắng trong khả năng hợp lý để thực hiện đúng lựa chọn của tôi ở trên, nhưng không thể bảo đảm hình ảnh của con tôi sẽ không vô tình xuất hiện trong các hoạt động hoặc sự kiện của Công ty. Tôi cũng hiểu rằng Công ty không thể kiểm soát việc các phụ huynh hoặc cá nhân khác đăng hình ảnh của con họ mà trong đó có thể có con tôi.
vi.pickupIntro: Những người dưới đây được phép đón con tôi mà PRA không cần liên hệ với tôi trước.
vi.contractNote: Hợp đồng nhập học hiện chỉ có bản tiếng Anh. Nếu cần giải thích thêm, ba mẹ vui lòng liên hệ văn phòng PRA trước khi ký.
